message.content: Columbia University is a private Ivy League research university located in New York City, United States. Founded in 1754 as King's College, it was renamed Columbia College in 1784 and later became Columbia University in 1896. It is one of the oldest institutions of higher education in the United States and is known for its rigorous academic programs, distinguished faculty, and notable alumni. The university comprises several undergraduate schools, graduate schools, and professional schools, including Columbia College (the undergraduate liberal arts college), the School of Engineering and Applied Science, the School of Social Work, the Graduate School of Arts and Sciences, the School of Journalism, the School of Law, the School of Medicine, the School of Public Health, the School of Architecture, the School of Business, and the School of Education. Columbia University is also home to many research centers and institutes, such as the Columbia Center for Research on Learning Disabilities, the Columbia Institute for Studies in International Affairs, and the Columbia Climate School.
